question: Which original seam information determines one common field, state and time action without confusing geometric reflection with boundary polarization?
summary_de: Der geometrische Decklift ist nicht allgemein 2P_C−I: ein kompakter Dirac-Kragen und das Hauptsymbol liefern den Gegenbeleg. Die vollständige Zwei-Flächen-Randrelation des gegebenen Produktoperators rekonstruiert B mit Vorzeichen und Beträgen. Unter geladener quasifreier CAR-Realisierung liefert dieselbe Graphkovarianz den eingeschränkten Zustand und den Zeitgenerator. Keine physische Quellenwahl aus P1/P2. Die wörtliche Plus-Kompression erzwingt epsilon_car=I und entfernt den für 3+2 benötigten negativen Sektor; eine andere Trägerfaktorisierung braucht eine eigene Abbildung.
summary_en: The geometric deck lift is not generally 2P_C−I: a compact Dirac collar and the principal symbol give counterevidence. The complete two-face boundary relation of a supplied product operator reconstructs signed B, including magnitudes. Under a charged quasifree CAR realization, the same graph covariance yields the restricted state and time generator. No physical source selection from P1/P2 is proved. The literal positive-only compression forces epsilon_car=I and removes the negative sector required for 3+2; a different carrier factorization needs its own map.
scope: Original geometric-operator audit; exact closed-graph spectral reconstruction for a given selfadjoint product collar, identified boundary faces and known normal length; conditional quasifree CAR state/time connection; finite rational executable inverse and Lean algebra.
assumptions: For reconstruction: an actual selfadjoint B exists in an exact normal-independent product collar; full labeled L2 endpoint relation and common fiber identification are supplied.
The positive normal length ell is independently given; otherwise only ell B is determined.
For state claims: charged CAR(H direct_sum H), quasifree statistics and occupation covariance equal to the supplied graph projection are additional physical identification premises.
Quarter holonomy is retained in the given operator domain, not derived from a Clifford quarter turn.
Any marking and local field dictionary must be carried in the same source frame; a noncommuting marking is not a function of B alone.
positive_results: Compact product-Dirac witness corrects the original general inference R_tau=2P_C-I.
The literal positive-only carrier compression forces epsilon_car=I and a zero negative sector; it cannot produce the subsequent 3+2 split. This does not refute the abstract given P2 carrier.
G_ell=[[A,C],[C,I-A]] with A=(I+exp(-2ell B))^-1 and C=(2cosh(ell B))^-1 reconstructs signed B=logit(A)/(2ell).
Unbounded domain correction: exp(-ell B)=closure(C A^-1), with raw domain Ran A=D(T^2).
The second-face quasifree covariance n=I-A obeys log((I-n)n^-1)=2ell B, using the same full graph.
Executable reader accepts a supplied rational full projection without supplied B and rejects sign-only or invalid inputs.
Lean certifies rational graph injectivity and the anticommuting-involution quarter-turn algebra; it does not certify the unbounded analytic theorem.
not_derived: Selection of the actual original P1/P2 full kernel, physical CAR algebra, state interpretation, normal scale or noncommuting marking.
P2 carrier realization, E8 extension, physical event law or complete T1-T8 solution.
